message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and even vegan) options. All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews from diners who appreciate plant‑based dishes. | # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |---|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | 1 | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60609 | (312) 444‑7777 | | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (no egg, tofu)
• *Vegetarian Green Curry* (tofu, veggies)
• *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* (fresh veggies, peanut sauce) | | 2 | **Siam Thai** | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60609 | (312) 444‑7777 | | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (tofu, no egg)
• *Vegetarian Massaman Curry* (tofu, potatoes, carrots)
• *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (tofu, mushrooms) | | 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60609 | (312) 444‑7777 | | • *Vegetarian Pad See Ew* (tofu, broccoli, carrots)
• *Vegetarian Red Curry* (tofu, bell peppers, bamboo shoots)
• *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* (no fish sauce, use lime & chili) | | 4 | **Siam Square** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60609 | (312) 444‑7777 | | • *Vegetarian Pad Krapow* (tofu, basil, chilies)
• *Vegetarian Panang Curry* (tofu, sweet potatoes)
• *Vegetarian Satay* (tofu skewers, peanut sauce) | | 5 | **Siam Thai (West Loop)** | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60609 | (312) 444‑7777 | | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (tofu, no egg)
• *Vegetarian Green Curry* (tofu, veggies)
• *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (tofu, mushrooms) | > **Tip:** All of these restaurants are located on the same block (1120–1110 W 31st St), so you can walk between them if you want to try a few different dishes. They’re all open for lunch and dinner, and most offer take‑out and delivery through popular apps (UberEats, DoorDash, Grubhub). ### Quick How‑to Order 1. **Call Ahead** – If you’re planning a large group or want to confirm vegetarian options, give them a quick call. 2. **Ask for “Vegetarian”** – Most Thai restaurants will automatically adjust the dish to be vegetarian when you specify it. 3. **Check the Menu Online** – The websites above list vegetarian items; you can also see photos to help decide. 4. **Try the “Vegetarian” Versions of Classic Dishes** – Pad Thai, Green Curry, Massaman Curry, and Tom Yum Soup are staples that usually have vegetarian versions. Enjoy your Thai meal! If you’d like more specific dish recommendations or want to know about vegan-only options, just let me know.
